gce.description: Credentials are retrieved from the GCE metadata server. Requires Grafana to be running on a Google Compute Engine virtual machine. No secrets are stored.

jwt.description: Service account credentials. Reads private and public spreadsheets. Set secureJsonData.privateKey to the `private_key` value from the service account JSON, or set jsonData.privateKeyPath to a file on the Grafana server instead.

key.description: Simplest configuration, but only reads spreadsheets that are shared publicly.
